definitions.short: probably to be heavy , i.e. (figuratively) honorable
definitions.full: H7336. razan [ רָזַן , ? earlier רָזן , so Lag BN 31 ] verb be weighty, judicious, commanding (Arabic be weighty, grave, firm of judgement ; Late Hebrew רוֺזֵן = Biblical Hebrew, so רוזנים Ecclus 44:4); — only Qal Participle plural as substantive, rulers, potentates , || מְלָכִים : רֹזְנִים Judg 5:3 ; Hab 1:10 , ׳רוֺ Psa 2:2 ; Prov 8:15 ; 31:4 , || אֶרֶץ שֹׁפְטֵי Isa 40:23 .
